args.query:
Check these parcel labels against our dispatch policy. Use the exact box identifiers, identify any defects and required corrections, and say which parcels can be dispatched. Cite the relevant policy sections.
dispatch-policy.md

PRIMARY TARGET USER ATTACHMENTS (Attached directly in this chat):
--- ATTACHED FILE: package-labels.md (text/markdown, 250 bytes) ---
# Dispatch label audit
Identifier: BOX-ORCHID
Destination: Bristol
Return address: 18 Willow Road, York
Tracking barcode: Present and readable

Identifier: BOX-CEDAR
Destination: Leeds
Return address: Missing
Tracking barcode: Present but unreadable

--- END ATTACHED FILE: package-labels.md ---

## 3 Tracking
Every parcel must have a readable tracking barcode. Reprint an unreadable barcode before dispatch.

[SOURCE: dispatch-policy.md; §2; Page 1; CHUNK: fixture-0-p1-3]
## 2 Return address
Every parcel must have a return address. Add the sender's return address if it is missing.

[SOURCE: dispatch-policy.md; §dispatch-label-requirements; Page 1; CHUNK: fixture-0-p1-1]
# Dispatch label requirements
Document ID: DISPATCH-POLICY

[SOURCE: dispatch-policy.md; §4; Page 1; CHUNK: fixture-0-p1-5]
## 4 Release
Do not dispatch a parcel until all label requirements are met.

[SOURCE: dispatch-policy.md; §1; Page 1; CHUNK: fixture-0-p1-2]
## 1 Destination
Every parcel must state its destination.
